channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Vitória de Arthur está em análise e Sampaio fica no cargo, diz TRE
item.description: The TRE-RR confirmed that Arthur Henrique (PL) received 60.87% of the vote (160,004 ballots) in Roraima's supplementary gubernatorial election, but was not proclaimed elected because his candidacy registration remains sub judice due to a ruling by Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino, who found a violation of the 6-month disassociation requirement. Meanwhile, Soldado Sampaio (Republicanos), president of the Legislative Assembly, continues as interim governor. The court states it awaits a final decision from higher electoral authorities before proclaiming the official result.

item.title: Alerta extremo na seleção
item.description: A false emergency alert in the middle of the night woke the author, who initially thought it was part of a nightmare related to a Brazil-Haiti match he had watched before sleeping. The content reveals the alert was a hoax, but uses the situation as a metaphor to criticize someone who hates humanity and seeks to destroy football, described as one of humanity’s greatest diversions. The article is exclusive to subscribers and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Prazo de prisão domiciliar de Bolsonaro termina na quinta; prorrogação depende de Moraes
item.description: The temporary house arrest of former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro ends on Thursday (25), with extension depending on a decision by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Bolsonaro is serving a 27-year and three-month sentence for leading a criminal organization that attempted a coup in 2022 to remain in power after losing the election. He was released from hospital after treatment for bronchopneumonia, but his defense requests additional medical exams due to worsening symptoms including persistent hiccups, fatigue, and balance issues, while his cardiac condition remains stable.

item.title: Arthur Henrique é o mais votado para o cargo de governador na eleição suplementar de Roraima
item.description: Arthur Henrique, from the Liberal Party (PL), was the most voted candidate in Roraima's supplementary gubernatorial election, receiving 60.87% of valid votes (160,004 votes), but his candidacy was rejected by the TRE-RR and remains sub judice pending a TSE decision. The ticket of Soldado Sampaio and Tayla Peres (Republicanos) came in second with 35.72% of votes. The TRE-RR did not proclaim the result, awaiting a decision from higher courts.

item.title: Moro reforça parceria com Tarcísio em campanha e quer copiar programa para saúde
item.description: Sergio Moro (PL), pre-candidate for governor of Paraná, said he plans to adopt health measures implemented by Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) in São Paulo, reinforcing state partnership and considering joint events to amplify policy impact.

item.title: Colombia dividida: la izquierda unida, la derecha se mueve al extremo
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections reveal a deeply divided nation, with the left united and the right shifting toward extremism, while traditional parties lose influence. Preliminary results show a technical tie between Abelardo de la Espriella and other candidates, reflecting growing polarization. Despite tacit support from established forces, there is concern that the winner may not fulfill key promises, while the left, led by figures like Iván Cepeda, asserts its decisive role in Congress and opposition.

item.title: Carlos diz que "renasceu" em SC para justificar candidatura ao Senado
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) announced his pre-candidacy for the Senate from Santa Catarina, claiming he 'was reborn' in the state despite not being born there. He framed the move as part of the PL's strategy to contest both Senate seats, running in a pure PL ticket with federal deputy Carol de Toni (PL-SC), backed by Jair Bolsonaro, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Governor Jorginho Mello. The decision caused tension with the PP, which had planned to nominate Esperidião Amin for one of the seats.

item.title: Janja posta vídeo e exalta campanha federal contra feminicídio
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva posted a video on Instagram praising the National Pact Against Femicide, emphasizing its role in strengthening protection, shelter, and justice for women and girls. Instituted in 2023 and formally signed in February 2026, the pact is coordinated by the Ministry of Women and involves cross-sectoral actions across three prevention axes, with recent progress including over 6,300 arrests in a national operation.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro sobre eleição na Colômbia: "Direita segue triunfando"
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) congratulated Abelardo de la Espriella, the right-wing candidate elected president of Colombia, in an Instagram video, stating the victory represents the 'triumph of the right in America' and the fight against narcoterrorism, corruption, and tax increases. He emphasized that the Colombian election reflects a growing trend of right-wing victories across the continent, with Espriella winning by approximately 250,000 votes over left-wing candidate Iván Cepeda, an ally of outgoing president Gustavo Petro.

item.title: Flávio comemora vitória de De la Espriella na Colômbia
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) celebrated the victory of Abelardo de la Espriella in Colombia's presidential runoff, calling it a 'victory of good over evil'. He stated that right-wing ideals are triumphing across Latin America, citing battles against narcoterrorism, corruption, and tax increases. Flávio also wished the elected leader wisdom, health, and strength to govern for the people's benefit.

item.title: Arthur Henrique, ex-prefeito de Boa Vista, vence eleição suplementar ao governo de Roraima com candidatura 'sub judice'
item.description: Arthur Henrique, former mayor of Boa Vista, won the supplementary election for governor of Roraima with 60.87% of the vote, but his candidacy remains sub judice after being deferred due to failure to comply with disaffiliation deadlines. He was backed by Flávio Bolsonaro and defeated Soldado Sampaio (Republicanos) and Nelita Frank (PT). The result awaits judgment by the TSE and STF.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro parabeniza Espriella por vitória na Colômbia e diz que direita segue triunfando
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) congratulated Abelardo de la Espriella on his victory in Colombia's presidential election, highlighting the advancement of the right in the region. He stated that the victory confirms the continued triumph of the right in Latin America. The preliminary result indicates the success of a political newcomer.

item.title: Arthur Henrique lidera em Roraima, mas vitória depende da Justiça
item.description: Arthur Henrique (PL) leads the supplementary election for governor of Roraima with 60.90% of valid votes, based on 99.19% of ballots counted, but his candidacy is contested due to failure to meet public office incompatibility deadlines after the Supreme Court struck down a rule allowing candidates to resign up to 24 hours before the election. The PL appealed to the Supreme Court, but Minister Edson Fachin denied the request, leaving the validity of Arthur’s votes pending a decision by the Electoral Justice. If his votes are annulled, the victory could go to Soldado Sampaio (Republicanos) with 35.74%, or be determined by further judicial rulings.

item.title: Ao alcançar PL, PP e PT, Caso Master testa os limites do cinismo dos eleitores
item.description: The Banco Master scandal has reached politicians from the PL, PP, and PT, including Flávio Bolsonaro, Ciro Nogueira, and Jaques Wagner, revealing a cross-partisan influence network that fuels the perception that all political actors act in self-interest. This strengthens electoral cynicism, where voters prioritize rejecting opponents over ethical considerations, potentially benefiting incumbents like Lula in a polarized environment. Although the scandal’s impact on Flávio Bolsonaro’s polling has been limited, some moderate antipathetic support may have eroded, though the duration of this shift remains uncertain.

item.title: Marcha da Maconha pede regulamentação e critica guerra às drogas
item.description: The 2026 Marijuana March gathered thousands on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo, advocating for cannabis legalization and regulation in Brazil, while criticizing the war on drugs and Governor Tarcísio de Freitas. The event marked 18 years of the march, featured PT deputy Eduardo Suplicy celebrating his 85th birthday, and included stickers with President Lula’s image — some demanding progress on legalization. Attendance estimates ranged from 10,000 (Poder360) to 60,000 (organizer).

item.title: Aila da Farmácia (Avante) é eleita prefeita de Amparo do Serra (MG)
item.description: Aila da Farmácia (Avante) was elected mayor of Amparo do Serra (MG) with 56.71% of valid votes in a supplementary election held on Sunday, June 21, defeating Tulio Cária (MDB). The election was required after the TSE confirmed the ineligibility of José Eduardo Barbosa Couto (PP), the top vote-getter in 2024, due to a criminal conviction under the Clean Record Law. The inauguration of the elected officials is scheduled for July 13.

item.title: Elo de Jaques Wagner com o Master será a primeiro teste de fogo da ‘Fórmula Janones’
item.description: The investigation into Senator Jaques Wagner's (PT-BA) links to the Banco Master scandal is serving as the first test of the 'Janones Formula', a digital communication strategy taught by federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) to shift focus from opposition attacks on social media. Janones instructed PT supporters to create their own versions of events — without necessarily lying — to control the narrative, citing his 2022 tactic of claiming to possess compromising content from Gustavo Bebianno's phone to deflect attacks on Lula. The PT is now attempting to apply this approach to counter allegations that its Senate leader benefited from Banco Master.

item.title: Lula vai ao Rio para assinar adesão do estado ao Propag nesta segunda
item.description: President Lula will travel to Rio de Janeiro on Monday to formalize the state's accession to the Propag program, which refinances state debts with the Union. The measure is expected to reduce Rio's monthly payment from R$ 490 million to R$ 113 million, allowing the state to exit the Fiscal Recovery Regime. Lula will also announce investments in peripheries and favelas in the capital.

item.title: Disputa ao governo de São Paulo tem segunda baixa em 48h
item.description: Former Santo André mayor Paulo Serra (PSDB) announced his withdrawal from the São Paulo gubernatorial race on Sunday, following federal deputy Kim Kataguiri (Missão), who stepped down on Saturday. With both candidates out, the contest remains between incumbent governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and former minister Fernando Haddad (PT), who lead in polls with 45.6% and 34.1% respectively. The withdrawals increase the likelihood of a first-round decision, with Tarcísio holding a clear advantage.

item.title: Marcha da Maconha reúne 7,4 mil pessoas em São Paulo, diz monitoramento da USP
item.description: The 15th edition of the Marijuana March gathered approximately 7,4 thousand people on São Paulo's Avenida Paulista on Sunday, June 21, 2026, according to monitoring by USP/CEBRAP in partnership with More in Common. The estimate, based on AI-analyzed aerial drone photography, has a 12% margin of error, indicating between 6,5 thousand and 8,3 thousand participants at peak time. The march presented itself as an autonomous, anti-racist, and anti-fascist movement advocating for an end to the 'war on drugs'.

item.title: Atraso no TSE deixa eleição de Roraima sob impasse jurídico
item.description: Roraima's supplementary election takes place amid a legal impasse following the TSE's 623-day delay in annulling the Denarium-Damião ticket, with tardy judicial decisions compressing the electoral calendar. Despite legal challenges, the candidacies of Arthur Henrique (PL) and Nelita Frank (PT) remained on the ballot, while Soldado Sampaio (Republicans) runs as interim governor. Voting occurred on Sunday, with vote counting starting at 7:30 PM, but the validity of votes hinges on future rulings by the TRE-RR and TSE.

item.title: Mendonça determina exclusão de vídeo publicado por Sóstenes que sugere financiamento do CV e PCC ao PT
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, acting as vice-president of the TSE, ordered the removal of a video posted by federal deputy Sóstenes Cavalcante (PL) that linked President Lula's government to financing by criminal factions CV and PCC. The ruling cited the absence of minimal evidence to support the claims, classifying the post as negative pre-campaign propaganda that unjustly damages political opponents' reputation without factual basis.

item.title: Lula e Flávio ajustam comunicação e palanques sob pressão do caso Master antes das convenções
item.description: With exactly one month until party conventions begin, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are adjusting communication strategies, alliances, and campaign platforms amid pressure from the Master case. The PT is focusing on aligning digital communication, reinforcing government achievements, and resolving legal issues, while Flávio’s circle aims to overcome the fallout from ties to Daniel Vorcaro, choose a running mate, and rebuild strategic state-level slates.

item.title: Projeto dispensa licitação para medicamentos da Hemobrás
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved a bill exempting Hemobrás, the sole national producer of blood-derived medicines, from public bidding requirements for SUS procurement. Authored by Deputy Jorge Solla (PT-BA), the measure aims to secure essential health supplies and save up to R$1 billion annually for the Ministry of Health. The bill passed 285-106 and will now proceed to the Senate.

item.title: A condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro, o Master e o pêndulo das instituições
item.description: The First Chamber of the Supreme Federal Court (STF) unanimously convicted Eduardo Bolsonaro to four years and two months in prison for attempted coercion related to pressuring the Donald Trump administration to impose sanctions on Brazilian authorities, rendering him ineligible for office for eight years. Bolsonaro claims he was not formally notified and accuses Justice Alexandre de Moraes of bias, arguing Moraes acted as both judge and victim. The piece critiques institutional selectivity, contrasting the swift ruling in Bolsonaro’s case with the unresolved, secret proceedings against former minister Gleisi Hoffmann since 2018.

item.title: Quando a investigação se aproxima do poder
item.description: The Lula government's decision to recall Federal Police deputies assigned to other bodies, including judges' offices, coincides with the advancement of the Master Case investigations, which now implicate both opposition figures and government officials. While the move raises concerns of political interference, the text emphasizes that the true test of institutional autonomy occurs when oversight bodies investigate government allies—not just opponents. Such institutions are vital for reducing information asymmetry between rulers and voters, even when their actions impose political costs on incumbents.

item.title: Bolsonaro presta depoimento no DF em semana em que vence prisão domiciliar
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro faces a critical decision regarding the maintenance or revocation of his house arrest, whose 90-day period ends on March 25. The measure was granted by STF Minister Alexandre de Moraes on March 24, 2024, for his recovery after hospitalization. This week will be decisive for his legal status.

item.title: Paulo Serra desiste de candidatura ao governo de SP e anuncia pré-candidatura a deputado federal
item.description: Former Santo André mayor Paulo Serra (PSDB) abandoned his bid for São Paulo governor in 2026 and announced a pre-candidacy for federal deputy, stating he wishes to contribute more effectively to the state and country. His decision follows Solidariedade and PRD endorsing Tarcísio de Freitas’ re-election, making his gubernatorial run unviable. Serra now aims to build a party alliance to support his federal campaign, emphasizing fiscal responsibility and administrative efficiency.

item.title: Congresso aprova educação política como disciplina obrigatória
item.description: On June 17, 2026, the Brazilian Federal Senate approved PL 4.088/2023, making 'political education and citizenship rights' a mandatory subject in basic education by amending Article 26 of the LDB. The bill, originally proposed by Deputy Renata Hellmeister (Podemos-SP), does not specify the grade level or teacher qualifications and received only one opposing vote, from Senator Hamilton Mourão (Republicanos-RS). It now awaits presidential sanction by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT).

item.title: Depois de Kataguiri, Paulo Serra (PSDB) também desiste de concorrer ao governo de São Paulo
item.description: Former mayor of Santo André, Paulo Serra (PSDB), withdrew from the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial race and will run for federal deputy, following Kim Kataguiri’s (Missão) decision to abandon his pré-candidacy for the Palácio dos Bandeirantes. With Serra and Kataguiri stepping down, the contest for governor now centers on incumbent Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos), who leads polls with 45.6% voter intent, and former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad (PT), at 34.1%. The poll margin of error is 2.5 percentage points.

item.title: 'Esperança vai vencer o medo': como surgiu slogan de Lula que Flávio copiou
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro repeated the slogan 'Hope will overcome fear', originally used by Lula in his 2002 presidential campaign. The phrase emerged after a reading of a poem by Pernambucan sociologist Gilberto Freyre at an event in Rio de Janeiro, which inspired the PT's narrative of hope against fear. Flávio's use of the slogan was noted as a direct copy of Lula's communication strategy.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia completa 20 anos como ministra do STF
item.description: Minister Cármen Lúcia completed 20 years of service at the STF on Sunday (June 21, 2026), being the first and only woman currently on the Court and responsible for drafting its ethics code. Appointed by Lula in 2006, she has previously presided over the STF, CNJ, and TSE twice, and acted as interim President of the Republic on four occasions. Commemorations include the publication of a book compiling her key votes and special content on TV Justiça, Rádio Justiça, and the STF’s digital platforms.

item.title: Após Kim, tucano também desiste de disputa ao governo de SP e Tarcísio e Haddad duelam para herdar votos
item.description: São Paulo tucans Paulo Serra (former mayor of Santo André) and Kim Kataguiri have withdrawn from the 2026 gubernatorial race, opting to run for federal deputy instead. Their exit reduces electoral fragmentation, leaving Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Fernando Haddad (PT) as the main contenders, with polls showing Tarcísio leading at 38% versus Haddad’s 26%. Neither tucano has yet endorsed another candidate.

item.title: A Copa 2026 e a política das emoções
item.description: Brazil's performance in the 2026 World Cup may influence voter behavior, as citizens often assign responsibility for uncontrollable events to governments. This undermines democratic rationality, since voting may reflect luck rather than governance quality. While autocrats exploit such events to boost popularity, their rule relies on force and repression, not electoral legitimacy.

item.title: Nunes aumenta participação em pré-campanhas de Flávio e Tarcísio
item.description: São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB) collaborated on three policy areas of presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) government plan: transportation, food security, and public safety. This alignment suggests strategic cooperation between the MDB and Bolsonaro’s faction on urban governance and public policy. The article was published on June 21, 2026, at 14:29.

item.title: Defesa é vital em audiência sobre tarifas dos EUA, diz economista
item.description: Economist Gustavo Sampaio, a professor at FGV, is the only Brazilian registered for the USTR public hearing on potential 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, set for July 6 in Washington. He notes the Brazilian government has not confirmed attendance and expresses distrust in the process, but stresses the importance of participating to avoid a default judgment. Sampaio also submitted documents to defend Pix as state infrastructure, arguing the proposed tariffs are 'analog solutions to digital problems'.

item.title: Paulo Serra desiste de concorrer ao governo de SP e ajuda Tarcísio
item.description: Former Santo André mayor Paulo Serra (PSDB) abandoned his gubernatorial pre-candidacy in São Paulo and announced he will run for federal deputy in 2026. His decision follows Kataguiri's withdrawal, consolidating right-wing support behind Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos), who leads polls with 45.6% voter intention. Both Serra (4.6%) and Kataguiri (3%) trailed Tarcísio and Haddad (PT) in recent surveys.

item.title: Zelenskiy aceita oferta de Lula para mediar paz na Ucrânia
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy accepted Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s proposal to mediate a peace agreement in the war with Russia, as confirmed by a Ukrainian presidential aide following their meeting at the G7 summit in France. Lula advocates for the involvement of the five permanent members of the UN Security Council (U.S., France, U.K., Russia, and China), emphasizing their veto power to decide on war or peace. Negotiations are progressing with a commitment to achieve concrete results based on proposed ideas, without additional conditions from Ukraine, aiming for a ceasefire to enable peace talks.

item.title: Dois ex-jogadores da Seleção Brasileira devem disputar vaga na Câmara em 2026
item.description: Two former Brazil national team players, Edmundo and Luís Fabiano, have confirmed their pre-candidacies for the Chamber of Deputies in the 2026 elections. Edmundo, nicknamed 'Animal', joined the PSDB in Rio de Janeiro and pledged to defend Vasco da Gama if elected. Luís Fabiano, known as 'Fabuloso', affiliated with the MDB in São Paulo with support from Mayor Ricardo Nunes and aims to focus his mandate on promoting sports and digital inclusion.

item.title: Fama mundial na Copa expõe distância entre Vozinha e outros goleiros
item.description: Cabo Verdean goalkeeper Vozinha gained global fame after holding Spain to a goalless draw in the 2026 World Cup, earning man-of-the-match honors and surging from 50,000 to over 13 million Instagram followers in days. Despite his newfound stardom, his monthly salary of €8,400 at GD Chaves is nearly 100 times lower than Brazil’s Alisson Becker, who earns €9.3 million annually at Liverpool. His market value of €50,000 also pales in comparison to Alisson’s €15 million valuation.

item.title: A próxima pesquisa intenção de voto para presidente
item.description: The PoderData poll to be released on Friday, June 26, will be based on 2,400 phone interviews with a two-point margin of error. President Lula (PT) leads the first round with 40%, followed by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 35%, while no other pre-candidate exceeds 4%. In a hypothetical runoff, Lula leads with 46% against Bolsonaro’s 42%, within the margin of error.

item.title: Área técnica do TCU cobra explicação da Caixa sobre licitação de publicidade de R$ 760 milhões
item.description: The technical area of the TCU requested explanations from Caixa regarding possible irregularities in a R$ 760 million annual advertising procurement, citing lack of objective criteria, improper use of 'best technique' over 'technique and price', and absence of public session recording. The case was filed by Cálix Propaganda, linked to publicist Marcello Lopes, former marketer for Flávio Bolsonaro. Caixa states its tenders comply with legislation and will provide clarifications to the court.

item.title: Zema reafirma críticas a Flávio Bolsonaro por relação com Vorcaro
item.description: Romeu Zema, the pré-candidate for president from the Novo party, reiterated his criticism of the closeness between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and banker Daniel Vorcaro, who is detained on allegations of leading a billion-dollar financial fraud scheme. In an interview on the podcast Cortadas do Firmino, Zema emphasized concerns about ethics and integrity in politics.

item.title: Por que eleitores de Roraima votam para governador neste domingo
item.description: Roraima voters go to the polls this Sunday in a supplementary election for governor and vice-governor after the TSE annulled Edilson Damião’s mandate due to political and economic abuse of power. Three tickets are competing: Arthur Henrique and Subtenente Velton (PL), whose candidacy is sub judice; Nelita Frank and Barto Macuxi (PT/PSOL); and Soldado Sampaio and Tayla Peres (Republicanos), with the current interim governor on the ticket. Voting is mandatory, and the winner will serve until January 2027, when the October-elected governor will take office.

item.title: Roraima elege neste domingo governador para mandato tampão até 2027
item.description: Roraima holds a supplementary gubernatorial election for a temporary term until 2027, following the removal of former governor Edilson Damião for political and economic abuse in 2022. Candidates include Arthur Henrique (PL), backed by the ousted governor and currently running 'sub judice' due to an STF challenge; Soldado Sampaio (Republicanos), the interim governor; and Nelita Frank (PT), from the opposition. Voting takes place this Sunday (21) from 8 AM to 5 PM across 350 polling stations, with 384,000 eligible voters.

item.title: Eleição para mandato tampão em Roraima acontece neste domingo
item.description: Roraima holds a supplementary election this Sunday to choose a governor for a temporary term until 2027, following the removal of former governor Edilson Damao for abuse of power. Three candidates are running: Arthur Henrique (PL), Soldado Sampaio (Republicanos), and Nelita Frank (PT), with Henrique facing potential disqualification due to a STF ruling on candidacy eligibility.

item.title: Neymar provoca nova briga entre direita e esquerda
item.description: President Lula's comment calling Neymar the 'first world home office call-up' sparked backlash from right-wing politicians like Flávio Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira, who defended the player and criticized the president. The controversy unfolded amid Brazil's preparations for the 2026 World Cup, with Neymar pursuing a historic sixth title and becoming a political symbol in the clash between bolsonarismo and lulismo. Despite Neymar's indirect response, the focus remained on the political instrumentalization of his image.

item.title: Joaquim Barbosa é desqualificado e pedirei revisão criminal, diz Delúbio
item.description: Delúbio Soares, former PT treasurer and federal deputy candidate for Goiás in 2026, claims innocence and plans to seek criminal revision of his Mensalão and Lava Jato convictions. He harshly criticizes former Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa, the rapporteur in the Mensalão case, calling him 'unqualified' and saying he would not invite him to dinner. Delúbio also mocks the possibility of Barbosa running for president in 2026 under the Christian Democracy party, stating that neither he nor voters see it as viable.

item.title: TSE manda excluir publicação de Sóstenes Cavalcante com acusação sem prova ao PT
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça ordered the removal of a social media post by federal deputy Sóstenes Cavalcante that linked the Workers' Party (PT) to criminal organizations without evidence, stating it exceeded the bounds of legitimate political criticism. The ruling mandates deletion within 24 hours, imposes daily fines for non-compliance, and bans reposting equivalent content.

item.title: Por que Flávio Bolsonaro se complicou mais que Wagner?
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro faced greater complications than Jaques Wagner because, while Wagner’s involvement is seen as an individual responsibility harming the government’s image, Flávio’s case directly undermines his presidential ambitions as a pre-candidate. Ricardo Noblat argues that Flávio’s situation carries institutional and personal gravity, tied to his national power project, unlike Wagner’s case, which does not implicate President Lula. This has isolated Flávio on the right, according to the Datafolha poll cited in the program.
